Using simulated HAADF-STEM images of monolayer MoS2, we set up two navigation tasks: one targeting a W dopant and the other targeting a grain boundary (Fig. 1a).
CLM-PROC-0072.statement: Typed Decision with Cosmos-Reason2 32B achieved a 43% navigation success rate in grain boundary navigation without noise.

extra_quotes: Inference was performed with vLLM56 on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, and the sampling parameters for generation followed the default values of each model.
The decision latency was defined as the mean time per decision, measured by sending requests one at a time.

Closed-loop navigation was evaluated for each combination of task, model, and decision method over 100 episodes, which combined 50 random seeds with two starting conditions (target inside or outside the initial FOV).

However, our evaluation was performed in a simulated environment, and we did not examine the effects of factors present in actual microscopes, such as specimen drift, instrument response delays, and beam damage52.
